title: hieracium canescens subsp. sublaeve
intro: Hieracium canescens subsp. sublaeve, commonly known as the yellow hawkweed, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that can aid in wound healing and reduce the risk of infections. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium canescens subsp. sublaeve are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
